name: SafifyNote
description: A professional Jupyter-style notebook for notes: rich text, code, and diagram cells, with PDF/PNG/JPG export and .sff file support.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob: https:; connect-src 'self' https://api.groq.com; frame-src 'self'
content_security_policy.sandbox: sandbox allow-scripts allow-modals; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; child-src 'self'
